theater: 黎凡特沿岸與貝卡谷地

battle.name: 後續的敘利亞戰役
battle.theater: 黎凡特沿岸與貝卡谷地
battle.brief: 公元前1270年，卡迭石之戰後的拉美西斯二世重整黎凡特戰線，主力沿奧龍特斯河北上，奪回叛離的杜普、圍困圖尼普，並在西頓救回被赫梯扣押的阿穆魯王族。步兵以銅矛列於盾牆之後，矛尖越過盾緣刺向戰車與攀城之敵，兩翼車兵反覆反衝。戰線在貝卡谷地拉鋸，最後走向和談。

kit.name: 埃及長矛
kit.history: 早王朝時期的長矛，銅或青銅矛頭綁在木杆上。埃及人用它守城垣，後來也用它收復失地。

countries: 這場後續的敘利亞戰役是拉美西斯二世的第二段戰爭：公元前1270年至1269年，新王國埃及對上赫梯帝國，戰場在黎凡特。埃及方面以法老本人任全軍統帥，帳下分阿蒙師、拉師、普塔師、塞特師四個步兵師，另有獨立的弓箭手大隊、精銳步兵「沙梅」與數百輛以上的戰車部隊充當兩翼先鋒，禁衛隊緊貼國王本人；拉美西斯北伐時通常留一半兵員在後方，由王子或維齊爾帕赫西主持。埃及的依賴者包括迦南諸城、比布魯斯與西頓等腓尼基城邦，以及北加利利的沙蘇遊牧部眾；相反地，阿穆魯、卡圖納與圖尼普一度倒向赫梯，赫梯王穆瓦塔里二世自率步兵與數千輛戰車北上，麾下有安納托利亞北方的盟軍，以及阿拉拉、基祖瓦、希馬等附庸。雙方在奧龍特斯河上游與貝卡谷地互相覬覦，爭的是沿海城市的稅收、迦南的穀物，以及通往西頓的商路。
countriesEn: These Syrian campaigns that followed were the second phase of the long war of Ramesses II: in 1270 and 1269 BC the New Kingdom of Egypt faced the Hittite empire in the Levant. On the Egyptian side the pharaoh himself was supreme commander, and the host was divided into four infantry divisions — the Amun, Ra, Ptah and Seth — backed by separate bodies of archers, picked elite foot soldiers, and a chariot corps of several hundred vehicles that formed the vanguard on both wings, with the royal guard in attendance on the king. When Ramesses marched north he normally left half of the army behind, under a prince or under the vizier Panhesy, and his Egyptian dependants included the cities of Canaan, the Phoenician ports such as Byblos and Sidon, and the Shasu pastoralists of northern Gilead. Against him stood Amurru, Qatna and Tunip, which had gone over to the Hittites; Muwatalli II led the Hittite army in person with his own infantry and several thousand chariots, supported by allies from northern Anatolia and by the client states of Arara, Kizzuwat and Hama. Both sides eyed the upper Orontes and the Beqaa valley, where the taxes of the coastal cities, the grain of Canaan and the trade road to Sidon were at stake.
people: 法老拉美西斯二世是全軍最高指揮，他的意志決定每一個作戰目標；其弟阿蒙-赫爾霍普以維齊爾身分在行軍途中主持營務，第8年圍攻杜普時留守營地的正是他，其後法老只帶精銳步兵前往西頓。埃及在阿穆魯的軍政官員梅奈負責前線行政與情報，同為敘利亞人的將軍賓阿娜特曾在阿穆魯與埃及之間周旋，試圖保住兩邊的關係。赫梯方面的穆瓦塔里二世自第5年卡迭石之戰起便同拉美西斯正面對抗，這一輪後續戰役中仍以御前親征的方式應對，並在西頓扣留阿穆魯王族作為要挾。拉美西斯之母圖雅與妻子妮斐爾泰麗在後方維持宮廷與祭祀運作，賽特神的祭司團隊則在阿蒙、拉兩師中擔任骨幹，使法老每次出征都同時帶著宗教與行政的權力。
peopleEn: Pharaoh Ramesses II was the supreme commander of the entire army, and his will decided every operational goal. His brother Amun-her-khepeshef, who served as vizier, ran the camp administration while the army marched, and it was he who was left in command of the camp during the siege of Dapur in year 8, after which the king took only the picked infantry on to Sidon. Mene, the Egyptian administrative officer in Amurru, handled front-line administration and intelligence, while Benanath, a Syrian general, moved between Amurru and Egypt trying to preserve relations on both sides. On the Hittite side Muwatalli II had faced Ramesses head-on since the battle of Kadesh in year 5, and he still met these renewed campaigns with the king himself in the field; at Sidon he held the Amurru princely family as a bargaining counter. Behind the lines, Ramesses' mother Tuya and his wife Nefertari kept the court and its ritual machinery running, and the priestly teams of Amun and Ra provided the backbone of two of the four divisions, so that every expedition carried religious and administrative authority at once.
kits: 卡面這支早王朝青銅矛頭綁在木杆上的埃及長矛，進入新王國時代後已演變成有套筒的青銅矛頭配束柄木杆，長度約兩米，是埃及步兵的制式兵器，也是全軍人數最多的裝備。埃及步兵縱列以盾兵在前、矛兵在後，前排「薩」兵種持長方盾，矛尖自盾緣上方探出，形成一道足以頂住戰車衝鋒的刺牆；後排「神力兵」用短矛與斧，用來破壞城牆與掩體，拋矛兵則在中距離發射。攻城時矛兵負責壓制城頭、守護填壕與雲梯的作業隊，攻入缺口後改用斧與短刀清理守軍。戰車兵另配長矛與彎刀，掩護步兵方陣兩翼並追擊潰兵。赫梯方面的步兵同樣以長矛為主，盾形偏小而尖，戰車單元與埃及一致，由兩匹或三匹馬牽引。埃及的銅料多來自西奈與提姆納產區，兵器作坊集中在孟斐斯與新都培爾-拉美西斯，供應數以萬計的矛頭與箭鏃。
kitsEn: The bronze spearhead lashed to a wooden shaft shown on the card belongs to the early dynastic period; by the New Kingdom it had evolved into a socketed bronze head fitted to a tang on a wooden shaft about two metres long, and it was the standard weapon of the Egyptian infantry and the most numerous piece of equipment in the army. Egyptian infantry formed up in a column with shield-bearers in front and spearmen behind. The front rank of the sa carried rectangular shields, and the spear points projected above the shield rims to form a bristling wall that could absorb the impact of charging chariots. The rear rank of the ntrj-tyw used short spears and axes to break walls and shelters, while javelin throwers engaged at medium range. In sieges the spearmen covered the working parties filling the ditch and moving the siege ladders, and once a breach was opened they went in with axes and short swords. Chariot crews carried spears and curved blades of their own, covering the flanks of the infantry blocks and pursuing the routed. Hittite infantry likewise fought with spears, behind smaller and more pointed shields, and their chariot units, as in Egypt, were drawn by two or three horses. Egyptian copper came mainly from Sinai and from Timna, and the workshops of Memphis and of the new capital Pi-Ramesses turned out spearheads and arrowheads by the tens of thousands.
tactics: 埃及的戰術重心是車步協同：先鋒戰車在兩翼展開，掩護步兵縱隊緩慢推進，行軍縱隊每日按固定時辰紮營，營地四方挖溝立柵，法老駐處立石柱記日，界碑一路插到邊境。遇城則改為圍城：壕溝填土、堆疊攻城梯、封堵門道、必要時以坑道掘入牆基，再以盾牆護住操作工兵，最後由矛兵與斧兵一齊壓上城頭。杜普的圍城戰就是這樣：城牆與護城河擋住正面進攻，埃及人靠掘進與破口取城，並在圍城期間截斷城內水源。杜普陷落後，埃及兵鋒轉向圖尼普與西頓，一路上以俘虜交換被扣的王族與城市，用戰俘做交換籌碼，試圖在談判桌上換回阿穆魯。赫梯則避免野外決戰，倚城固守、以遊騎與沙蘇襲擾埃及糧道，等埃及縱隊拉長、糧草不繼再反擊；埃及軍的補給靠尼羅河船隊運到奧龍特斯河口的基地，再由陸隊與驢隊分送前線。
tacticsEn: The tactical core of the Egyptian army was the combination of chariots and infantry: chariot teams opened out on both wings and covered the slow advance of the infantry column; the marching camp was pitched at fixed hours each day, with a ditch and a palisade on four sides, a stone pillar recording the day stood at the king's quarters, and boundary stones were planted along the line of march. When a city appeared the operation turned into a siege: the ditch was filled, siege ladders were stacked against the wall, gates were blocked, tunnels were driven under the foundations where necessary, shield walls covered the working parties, and finally spearmen and axe-men surged over the parapet together. The siege of Dapur followed that pattern, with the wall and its moat holding off the frontal assault until the Egyptians broke in by mine and breach, and with the water supply inside the city cut during the investment. Once Dapur had fallen the Egyptian thrust turned towards Tunip and Sidon, and along the way the king used prisoners in exchange for the detained princely family and for cities, trading captives as counters at the negotiating table in the hope of buying Amurru back. The Hittites avoided pitched battle in the open: they held their cities, sent riders and Shasu raiders against the Egyptian supply line, and waited for the Egyptian column to overstretch and run short of food before striking back. Egyptian supply came up the Nile by ship to a base near the mouth of the Orontes and was then carried inland by troops and donkey trains.
data: 這一段戰事留下的硬數字不多，但有幾組可核。時間上，埃及以王位年記事：第5年卡迭石之戰，第8年圍杜普、圖尼普並在西頓救回阿穆魯王族，第9年再入北部，第10年留下貝魯特石碑一類的勝利刻石，到第21年才簽下埃及與赫梯和約。距離上，從孟斐斯到西頓的陸路約三百五十公里，埃及的車步縱隊每日推進約二十到三十公里，戰車一日可跑六十公里以上。兵員方面，這幾次戰役的埃及步兵以萬計，戰車數以百計；同為青銅時代末期規模最大的卡迭石之役，學界對戰車數的估計差異頗大，赫梯方面常被引用的數字是五千輛上下，埃及方面則在二千至三千輛之間，其中央王近衛的戰車約六百輛，阿蒙、拉兩師是全軍主力。銅料供應方面，提姆納與西奈礦區的開採量在這個時期達到高位，兵器作坊一年可出矛頭以萬計。考古方面，拿赫爾卡爾布一地的界碑有數十件，杜普與圖尼普的戰役銘文也留有數份，加上第21年兩國和約的埃及與赫梯兩份文本，是這場戰爭最硬的文件證據。
dataEn: Hard figures for this stretch of the war are few, but a few sets can be checked. In time, the Egyptians dated events by regnal year: year 5 for the battle of Kadesh, year 8 for the siege of Dapur and Tunip and the recovery of the Amurru prince at Sidon, year 9 for another drive into the north, year 10 for the victory stelae of the Beirut type, and year 21 for the Egyptian-Hittite treaty. In distance, the land road from Memphis to Sidon runs some three hundred and fifty kilometres; the Egyptian chariot-and-foot columns advanced about twenty to thirty kilometres a day, while chariots could cover more than sixty. In strength, the Egyptian infantry in these campaigns numbered in the thousands at least, with chariots in the hundreds. For comparison, in the largest battle of the late Bronze Age, Kadesh, estimates of the chariot numbers differ widely: the figure usually cited for the Hittites is around five thousand, while the Egyptian side is put between two and three thousand, of whom about six hundred were the royal guard chariots, and the Amun and Ra divisions formed the core of the foot. On the supply side, the extraction of copper from Timna and Sinai reached its high point in this period, and the workshops could turn out tens of thousands of spearheads a year. In the archaeological record, the Nahr el-Kalb stelae number several dozen pieces, the campaign inscriptions of Dapur and Tunip survive in a few copies, and the treaty itself survives in two texts, Egyptian and Hittite — the hardest documentary evidence this war leaves behind.
cause: 打起來的原因有兩條線。埃及這一邊，拉美西斯二世在卡迭石受挫之後並不打算退回去，他要把整個黎凡特走廊握在手裡，理由很實際：北方三角洲的新都培爾-拉美西斯需要穩定的糧食與稅源，迦南的葡萄、橄欖與穀物是埃及宮廷的重要進項，腓尼基城市的商路與雪松木材也要靠這條線維持。赫梯這一邊，穆瓦塔里二世不能容許埃及把阿穆魯、卡圖納、圖尼普收成自己的附庸；阿穆魯的首領在赫梯支援下脫離埃及，殺死埃及任命的官吏，杜普與圖尼普關閉城門迎入赫梯守軍，於是埃及有理由再打。兩國之間多年沒有穩定的邊界協議，任何一方在阿穆魯或西頓的權力變動都會被另一方視為必須出手的理由。第三條線是沙蘇遊牧部眾在東北部與約旦河東岸的劫掠，埃及每次北上都必須先解決這條線，才敢把縱隊推到更深的地方。
causeEn: There were two lines of causation. On the Egyptian side, Ramesses II, having been checked at Kadesh, had no intention of giving way; he meant to hold the whole Levantine corridor, and the reasons were practical, since the new capital Pi-Ramesses in the northern delta needed a stable supply of grain and taxes, the vines, olives and cereals of Canaan were important revenue for the Egyptian court, and the trade roads and cedar timber of the Phoenician cities depended on the same corridor. On the Hittite side, Muwatalli II could not allow Egypt to turn Amurru, Qatna and Tunip into its own vassals; the rulers of Amurru, backed by Hatti, broke away from Egypt and killed the Egyptian officials, while Dapur and Tunip shut their gates and took in Hittite garrisons, which gave Egypt both the excuse and the need to fight again. The two kingdoms had never settled a stable frontier, so any change of authority at Amurru or Sidon on one side was read on the other as a reason to strike. A third line was the raiding of the Shasu pastoralists in the east and across the Jordan, and every Egyptian advance north had to settle that question first before the column could be pushed further inland.
impact: 對當時來說，這一輪後續戰役的結果是僵持而不是勝負：埃及拿回杜普與圖尼普的城防，救回阿穆魯王族，卻沒有能把阿穆魯變成埃及的穩固屬地；赫梯也沒有把埃及逐出黎凡特。真正改變局勢的是僵持本身——雙方都明白再打下去要付出極高的運力與銅料成本，第21年簽下的埃及—赫梯和約現存埃及與赫梯兩份文本，是有文字記載的最早國際和約，兩國約定互相承認邊界、互不侵犯，並且在對方遇襲時提供援助。埃及藉此把東方的邊界線推回西奈，在黎凡特與沙漠沿線重新立下界標，並在邊官的巡視與紀年銘文中把自己的疆域寫定；赫梯則換來了數百年的南方緩衝，可以回去收拾內部的穆爾西里危機。也因為埃及在戰後把重心轉向東方的城市建設與尼羅河三角洲的整頓，後世的學者多把這場戰爭看成埃及由擴張轉向守成的分水嶺。
impactEn: For the time, the outcome of this round of renewed campaigns was stalemate rather than victory: Egypt recovered the defences of Dapur and Tunip and freed the Amurru princely family, but could not turn Amurru into a stable possession; the Hittites, for their part, failed to drive Egypt out of the Levant. What really changed the situation was the stalemate itself, since both sides understood that another round would cost an enormous amount of transport and copper. The Egyptian-Hittite treaty signed in year 21 survives in an Egyptian and a Hittite text, and it is the earliest international treaty known from written documents: the two powers agreed to recognise a frontier, not to attack each other, and to come to the other's aid if it were attacked. Egypt used the settlement to push its eastern frontier back towards Sinai, re-planting boundary markers along the Levantine and desert lines and fixing the extent of its dominions in the annals and inspection records of the frontier officials; the Hittites in exchange obtained several centuries of southern buffer space, enough to go home and settle the internal Mursili crisis. And because after the war Egypt shifted its weight towards building cities in the east and reorganising the Nile delta, later historians have generally taken this war as the watershed between Egyptian expansion and Egyptian consolidation.
result: 公元前1270年至1269年的這段後續戰役，埃及在貝卡谷地取得局部成果：杜普淪陷、圖尼普被圍、阿穆魯王族在西頓獲釋並一度回到埃及，埃及的戰車部隊重新控制了奧龍特斯河下游的通道；但赫梯隨即扶植新的阿穆魯首領，戰線在貝卡谷地與黎凡特南部反覆拉鋸，雙方都拿不下對方。埃及沒有取得決定性的戰果，整場拉美西斯戰爭最終以第21年的埃及—赫梯和約收束：兩國劃定邊界、互相承認對方在亞細亞的權益，埃及退出一部分內陸據點，換取赫梯放棄西頓與阿穆魯方向的爭奪。對埃及而言，這場僵持的直接後果是把首都與行政重心搬到尼羅河三角洲東北部的新城培爾-拉美西斯，並在往後近三百年裡把西奈與沿海走廊視為固定的南方邊界。
resultEn: In the Syrian campaigns of 1270 and 1269 BC Egypt won local successes in the Beqaa: Dapur fell, Tunip was besieged, and the Amurru princely family was freed at Sidon and for a time returned to Egypt, and the Egyptian chariot corps again controlled the approaches below the Orontes. But the Hittites promptly installed a new ruler in Amurru, the front oscillated through the Beqaa and southern Levant, and neither side could take the other. Egypt achieved no decisive result, and the whole of the war of Ramesses II was ended instead by the Egyptian-Hittite treaty of year 21: a frontier was drawn, each side recognised the other's interests in Asia, and Egypt withdrew from some inland positions in exchange for the Hittites giving up their claim on Sidon and on Amurru. For Egypt the direct consequence of this deadlock was the transfer of the capital and the administrative centre to the new city of Pi-Ramesses in the north-eastern delta, and for close to three centuries thereafter the Sinai and the coastal corridor were treated as the fixed southern frontier.
